newsitem.title: USA: Time debuts Sports Illustrated Women/Sport.
newsitem.headline: Time debuts Sports Illustrated Women/Sport.

text.p: Time Inc. will debut the first test issue of Sports Illustrated Women/Sport on April 21 with a cover price of $2.95.

The magazine, aimed at women 18-34, will be sent to 450,000 female Sports Illustrated subscribers and to women selected from a Time Warner database, and 215,000 copies will be allocated to newsstand sales.
Sports Illustrated Women/Sport's first issue will have more than 100 editorial pages and 70 advertising pages. Its rate base is 600,000 and its page rate is $25,000.
Sports Illustrated Olympics Editor Sandy Bailey is to oversee the editorial content, said Time's parent, Time Warner Inc.
The new magazine is to be published twice in 1997, with the frequency for 1998 still to be determined.
